name: gemini-research-mcp
description: AI-powered research using Gemini 3.7 and FastMCP 4 with compact tool search and recoverable Deep Research
long_description:
MCP server providing AI-powered research capabilities using Google Gemini 3.7 and FastMCP 4.0.0b5:

- **research_web**: Fast web research with Gemini grounding (5-30 seconds)
- **research_deep**: Autonomous research with recoverable session storage and modern steps/output_text report extraction
- **research_deep_max**: Maximum-comprehensiveness research with visualization and collaborative planning
- **search_tools** / **call_tool**: Compact BM25 discovery and invocation of utility tools
- **resume_research** / **export_research_session**: Recover sessions and persist Markdown, JSON, or DOCX artifacts

The server supports stdio and guarded streamable HTTP transports plus shared Disk/Redis storage.

tools.name: research_web
tools.description: Fast web research with Gemini grounding (5-30 seconds). Use for fact-checking, current events, and documentation.

tools.name: research_deep
tools.description: Default Deep Research agent with task progress, recovery, optional visualization, and collaborative planning.

tools.name: research_deep_max
tools.description: Maximum-comprehensiveness Deep Research for exhaustive, high-stakes, due-diligence, market-map, literature-review, and offline workflows.

tools.name: resume_research
tools.description: Recover interrupted or in-progress research sessions.

tools.name: export_research_session
tools.description: Export completed research to persistent Markdown, JSON, or Word (DOCX) artifacts and disk files.

tools.name: search_tools

tools.name: call_tool

tools.name: fetch_webpage

tools.name: list_format_templates

tools.name: refine_research_plan

tools.name: inspect_mcp_server_for_gemini
tools.description: Inspect a remote MCP server for Gemini schema and allowed-tools compatibility.
